article.story: HUNTINGTON, W.Va. -- — Bryce Slay’s 33 points led Marshall over Prairie View A&M 64-58 on Wednesday. Slay added nine rebounds and three steals for the Thundering Herd (3-4). Emmanuel Manyuon scored 11 points while shooting 4 for 5, including 2 for 3 from beyond the arc, and added eight rebounds. Noah Otshudi shot 3 of 15 from the field, including 0 for 4 from 3-point range, and went 5 for 8 from the line to finish with 11 points. Jaylen Lee led the way for the Panthers (2-5) with 15 points. Prairie View A&M also got 13 points, six rebounds and three steals from Michael Eley. Davian Williams finished with 11 points, six rebounds and three steals. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
